observation_summary: The Week constructor was incorrectly using the default time zone instead of the provided time zone argument when creating a new Week object.
reasoning_summary: The fix changes a parameter passed to a constructor call within the Week class. The original code ignored the 'zone' parameter passed to the constructor and instead used 'RegularTimePeriod.DEFAULT_TIME_ZONE'. This is a classic communication/interface error where the correct information (the provided time zone) was not being passed to the underlying implementation.

alternative_types.why_not_primary: While it involves an initialization, the root cause is the incorrect passing of a parameter to a constructor (an interface/call issue) rather than a simple assignment error.
